blocks.text: Dimples Romana received another marriage proposal from her husband, Boyet Ahmee, during their trip to the City of Love, Paris, France. Ahmee shared a video of the romantic moment on Instagram on Wednesday, Nov. 18, showing him popping the question anew in front of the Eiffel Tower. The couple was initially seen dancing and goofing around to the tune of Jason Derulo’s “Trumpets” before Ahmee went down on one knee and proposed to Romana again.
